title: When the Colony Burns
premise: Sebastian Montrose, a xenolinguist haunted by dreams that arrive in languages no longer spoken, discovers a name on the manifest of the Halcyon Reach — a colony ship that officially never flew. The manifest lists her own mother, who died decades ago in a massacre every archive insists never happened. As Sebastian follows the ghost route between dead colonies, she uncovers a corporate erasure machine rewriting memory itself, and finds an unlikely found family among the route's last holdouts: a disgraced archivist, a stowaway engineer, and a dying AI that remembers everything. In the climax, Sebastian broadcasts the recovered massacre records through the dream-language only she can still speak, forcing the corporation's cover-up to collapse publicly — and finally letting her mother rest. The story ends with Sebastian staying on the route, no longer running between worlds, but keeping them connected.
about_author: Rafael Vane is the pen name of a former shipping-logistics analyst who spent a decade writing route reports between orbital stations before turning those itineraries into fiction. They live somewhere with unreliable internet and write exclusively at night, claiming the dark helps them hear the dead languages.

chapters.title: The Manifest That Never Was
chapters.summary: Sebastian Montrose, mid-route on a cargo hauler, decodes a corrupted manifest for the Halcyon Reach — a ship that officially never flew — and finds her mother's name on it. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: quiet vertigo, the first crack in a life built on forgetting.

chapters.title: Dead Route, Living Ghosts
chapters.summary: Sebastian detours to the derelict colony of Meridian Hollow, site of the supposed massacre, and finds the settlement physically erased — foundations scrubbed, records voided. She meets archivist Oyelaran, exiled for asking the same questions. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: dread hardening into purpose.

chapters.title: What the AI Remembers
chapters.summary: The colony's half-dead station AI, VESPER, fragments recall the massacre in dreamlike bursts — the same language Sebastian dreams in. She realizes her linguistic gift is inherited from survivors' neural implants. POV: Sebastian, with VESPER interludes. Emotional beat: grief becoming evidence.

chapters.title: A Stowaway with Steady Hands
chapters.summary: Engineer Juno Park, caught stowing away on Sebastian's ship, turns out to be the daughter of another erased colonist. Reluctantly, Sebastian takes her on. The corporation's retrieval agents begin tracking them. POV: Juno. Emotional beat: two strangers choosing each other.

chapters.title: The Company of Clean Hands
chapters.summary: On the hub world Callisto Verde, Sebastian confronts Meridian Terraforming's archivist-general, who offers her a comfortable lie: her mother never existed, so neither did her grief. She refuses. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: temptation and defiance; the stakes become personal and public.

chapters.title: Route of the Unspoken
chapters.summary: Chased off-grid, the trio follows VESPER's coordinates to a hidden relay where massacre survivors' descendants still whisper the erased language to their children. Sebastian, fluent at last, is welcomed. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: belonging — the found family becomes real.

chapters.title: Burn Pattern
chapters.summary: The relay is raided. Oyelaran is captured, and the survivors scatter. Juno is wounded; Sebastian must choose between saving the archive copy and saving her people. POV: Juno. Emotional beat: sacrifice, and the cost of proof.

chapters.title: The Trial of Memory
chapters.summary: Sebastian trades herself to the corporation, negotiating a public 'audit' she intends to turn into a trial. Inside Meridian's memory-vault, she finds the original massacre records — and her mother's final transmission. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: confrontation with the truth she feared.

chapters.title: Dreaming in the Mother Tongue
chapters.summary: Climax: Sebastian hijacks the corporation's own broadcast lattice and transmits the records in the dream-language, which bypasses the erasure filters because no one thought to censor what they couldn't read. The colonies wake to the massacre. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: catharsis — the silenced finally heard.

chapters.title: When the Colony Burns
chapters.summary: In the aftermath, the route is reopened, Oyelaran freed, VESPER restored as witness-keeper. Sebastian visits her mother's memorial on reborn Meridian Hollow, dreams in human words at last — but keeps the old language too. POV: Sebastian. Emotional beat: resolution — memory kept, family found, home chosen.
